intent: A thread-safe, time-ordered queue of BedrockCommands keyed by scheduled time and timeout, from which worker threads block-and-wait for the next command that is either already timed out or due to run.

objects.name: BedrockCommandQueue
objects.role: push/get/_dequeue, the timed-out-vs-scheduled ordering rule, and empty/size/clear/getAll queries

objects.name: BedrockCommandQueue::timeout_error
objects.role: thrown by get() when its wait window elapses with nothing available

objects.name: BedrockCommandQueue::ItemTimeoutPair
objects.role: pairs a queued command with its timeout for the parallel _lookupByTimeout index

naming_quality.note: Timeout and Scheduled are both bare uint64_t typedefs, mutually assignable with nothing at the type level stopping one being passed where the other is expected
